== Course of events ==

The discovery came in the Jackdaws' nest, where the travelers had taken shelter after their audience with Glinda the Good. It was here that the Scarecrow discovered he had lost the pepper-box containing the two remaining Wishing Pills, apparently left behind in the nest.

The loss left the Scarecrow without the magical pills he had been carrying. Soon after, the Scarecrow explained to Glinda the Good that Jinjur's Army of Revolt had seized the Emerald City and stolen its emerald jewels, asking the Sorceress for her help — while the travelers themselves lingered at the nest until daylight, gathering jewels and trinkets from among the Jackdaws' hoard.
